subject: Scheduling dedicated sizing call + technical deep dive with Orbitale
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@orbitale.ai>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@orbitale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling dedicated sizing call + technical deep dive with Orbitale

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Orbitale is planning to roll out an LLM-powered summarization feature across two product tiers (beta internal rollout Q1, public in Q2). Expected peak QPS is ~180 req/s with 2–4k tokens per session for core workflows; latency SLO target is 150ms p50 and <400ms p95 for API calls. You mentioned strict data residency and an eventual need for a private deployment, but for now you want a dedicated Redwood pool to guarantee throughput.

Next concrete step: lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive / sizing call to validate the load profile, confirm model family choices, and walk through our dedicated pool runbook (autoscale/burst settings, KV cache warmup, monitoring hooks).

Proposed agenda (60–90m):
- Confirm traffic pattern (QPS, session lengths, burst behavior)
- Throughput & latency targets per endpoint
- Model selection & quantization tradeoffs
- Autoscaling/capacity policy and failover plan
- Attachments / evidence we need from Orbitale (sample traffic CSV, preferred regions)

I've attached a short runbook template and the data points we typically ask for. Can you share your preferred 60–90 minute windows next week? I can coordinate with Ben and Karthik on the technical side.

Thanks — look forward to locking a slot.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap. The numbers you pulled match our internal estimates (we ran a quick retrospective on the discovery notes). We're available for a deep dive next week on the following slots (Pacific time):
- Tue Dec 22, 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed Dec 23, 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu Dec 24, 8:00–9:00 AM PT (shorter slot)

I've attached a sample load CSV (orbitale-load-profile.csv) and a short architecture sketch for context. For the meeting we expect to bring our infra lead (Priya) plus one backend engineer.

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood share an ops contact who will own the dedicated pool conversation?
2) We have a rough compliance window — could you confirm which regions Redwood supports for dedicated pools in your hosted offering?

Thanks —
Alex Liu
Head of Platform Integrations | Orbitale
alex.liu@orbitale.ai

- A list of internal POCs who need access to the session

I'll put a calendar hold for Tue Dec 22 10:00–11:30 AM PT and share a Google Meet with an agenda. If you later prefer Wed, we'll flip it.
